headline: Izmo develops indigenous pitch detector for defense avionics
hook: New defense tech milestone for Izmo
summary: Izmo Limited's subsidiary, Izmo Microsystems, has successfully developed and qualified an indigenous pitch detector for defense avionics. This specialized component is essential for aircraft navigation and flight control systems. The qualification allows the company to participate in strategic defense projects under the 'Make in India' initiative. This development signals the company's diversification from automotive software into high-precision defense electronics.
why_it_matters: New defense tech opens high-value revenue streams.
winners_losers: Izmo gains / Foreign avionics suppliers hurt
